title: Build independent CCP2 conformance corpus
description: Create revision-specific schema, independent wire/policy/state-transition fixtures and real production consumers for CCP2-001..026 per docs/ccp-conformance.md. Preserve legacy fixtures and classify their applicability. Use independent FNV/bitset/LoRa-airtime/interval-ledger arithmetic and independently constructed signed wire objects, not production-generated expected results. Cover counts1..255 including128 and256rejection, sparse/global indices, masks beyond32/64bits, asymmetric densities, sender-versus-receiver context, stale generations, actual receiver/half-duplex commitments, persistent hash collisions, complete-operation fit, ordinary-data-is-not-beacon, legal/accounting aliases and queue policy. Include corrected narrowband/300ms mathematical cases as feasibility evidence, not activation. Reuse worker6-cmj5, xzen, jnn2, 1lfx, jhfm, 7va6, cdwm and fa4t after checking what is already fixed; no local reimplementation of the production algorithm in consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen independent provenance and exact revision IDs; unknown fixture shapes and zero-consumption fail; Python/Rust/C consumers invoke real APIs; parser fuzz corpus and documented negative cases; no weakened legacy tests or round-trip-only/self-oracle proof. Three independent reviews for source changes, findings filed and resolved. Policy/wire evidence distinguished from production and RF compliance.
